entries.runtimeUse: Disciples, neighbors, Pharisees, Judean authorities and parents map sprites
entries.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: isolated supporting-character sprite atlas for a three-quarter top-down RPG. On a perfectly flat uniform pale cream #F7F0DE background, present exactly eight isolated full-body first-century Judean adults in a precise 4 columns by 2 rows grid, one centered person per equal cell, generous margin, no overlap, no grid lines and no labels. Exact cell order: row 1: male disciple A in muted blue-gray wrap; male disciple B in dusty olive wrap; male neighbor in sand tunic; female neighbor in muted terracotta wrap. Row 2: restrained older male Pharisee in layered natural linen and muted plum-brown shawl; second Judean authority in a different dusty-olive layered robe; the man's father in worn sand and brown garments; the man's mother in a modest muted-blue head covering and natural-linen dress. Middle Eastern appearances, varied but believable faces and ages, adult anatomy with head about one seventh body height, plain leather sandals. Neutral attentive or questioning expressions, hands low, no theatrical accusation. Fixed three-quarter top-down game camera, polished warm hand-painted storybook realism, clean silhouettes, upper-left natural light and compact soft grounding shadows. The image must contain only the eight figures and flat empty background: absolutely no title, caption, role name, numbering, lettering, symbol, border, grid line or typography anywhere.
must: Exactly eight people in exact 4x2 cell order
Distinct readable identities with coherent period clothing
avoid: Crowd scene, overlapping people or clipped bodies
Text, grid lines, borders, UI, watermark
visualAcceptance: All eight requested roles appear in exact order
Group roles remain distinct without moral caricature
Each silhouette reads at 96-112 runtime pixels tall
Palette, perspective, materials and lighting match core actors
No forbidden theological or period content
